operations.title: Update Security Incident
operations.description: Updates the owner, status, comments, and other details of existing incidents based on the incident ID that you have specified.

parameters.title: Incident ID
parameters.name: incidentID
parameters.tooltip: Unique identifier to represent the incident

parameters.title: Status
parameters.name: status
parameters.tooltip: Specify the status of the incident.

parameters.title: Assigned To
parameters.name: assignedTo
parameters.tooltip: Specify the owner of the incident.

parameters.title: Classification
parameters.name: classification
parameters.tooltip: Select the classification of the incident.

True Positive.title: Determination
True Positive.name: determination
True Positive.description: Specifies that the incident was a malicious activity.

Informational Expected Activity.title: Determination
Informational Expected Activity.name: determination
Informational Expected Activity.description: Specifies that the activity related to the incident was expected. For example, a security test.

False Positive.title: Determination
False Positive.name: determination
False Positive.description: Specifies that the activity was non-malicious.

Unknown.title: Determination
Unknown.name: determination
Unknown.description: Specifies that the activity was unknown.

Unknown Future Value.title: Determination
Unknown Future Value.name: determination
Unknown Future Value.description: Specifies that the activity is an unknown future value.

parameters.title: Custom Tags
parameters.name: customTags
parameters.tooltip: Array of custom tags associated with an incident.

parameters.title: Resolving Comment
parameters.name: resolvingComment
parameters.tooltip: User input that explains the resolution of the incident.

operations.title: Get Security Incidents
operations.description: Fetch XDR Incidents via MS Graph API

parameters.title: Filter
parameters.name: filter
parameters.tooltip: OData filter expression. Example: status eq 'new'

parameters.title: Expand Alerts
parameters.name: expandAlerts
parameters.tooltip: Fetch each alert associated with the incident.

parameters.title: Include Count
parameters.name: includeCount
parameters.tooltip: Return the total number of matching alerts.

operations.title: Run Advanced Hunting
operations.description: Advanced hunting is a query based threat-hunting tool that lets you explore raw data based on the 'Query' and 'Timespan' parameters.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Specify the query for Advanced Hunting.

parameters.title: Timespan
parameters.name: timespan
parameters.tooltip: ISO 8601 format for durations. Example: PT1H: Last 1 hour, PT12H: Last 12 hours, P1D: Last 24 hours, P2D: Last 2 days)

operations.title: Get Security Alerts
operations.description: Fetch XDR alerts via MS Graph API

parameters.title: Filter
parameters.name: filter
parameters.tooltip: OData filter expression. Example: status eq 'new', serviceSource eq 'microsoftSentinel'

operations.title: Get Security Alert
operations.description: Fetch XDR alert based on alert ID.
